svg.text: Control bundle from G_ID (count in brackets)
Feedback / forwarded value to an earlier stage
Hazard / forwarding control; short stubs connect by name
Pipeline register (stall / flush inputs on the bottom)
Memory / address mux (toolflow loads IMem and DMem)
Dots are junctions; plain crossings are not connected. '0' = tied low.
ctrl_ID / ctrl_EX (12): Halt, RegWr, andlink, Mem2Reg, MemRd, DMemWr, jumpreg, jump, branch, alusrc,
alusrca (2b), aluop (2b). _ID names: s_Halt_ID, s_RegWr_ID, s_andlink, s_memtoreg, s_memread, ...
ctrl_EX (8) into G_EX_MEM: halt, RegWr, andlink, Mem2Reg, MemRd, DMemWr, jumpreg, jump (+ s_pcsrc).
ctrl_MEM (8) into G_MEM: the 8 above as _MEM (s_pcsrc_MEM on its own wire).
ctrl_MEM (4) into G_MEM_WB and ctrl_WB (4) into G_WB: halt, RegWr, andlink, Mem2Reg.
Taps out of bundles: s_jump_EX, s_jumpreg_EX (fetch, hazard); s_memread_EX (hazard);
iCLK and iRST go to IMem, DMem, G_IF, G_ID, G_EX, G_MEM, G_WB and every pipeline register.
Ports mapped to open: G_IF current_PC / o_inst; G_ID o_PC / o_PCplus4 / o_inst;
G_EX pass-through outputs (halt ... jump, rd2, PCplus4, inst); G_MEM pass-through outputs.
s_Ovfl <= '0'. G_FWD_A / G_FWD_B input 11 tied to 0. s_add2out_MEM (EX_MEM) is unused.
Testbench taps: s_RegWr, s_RegWrAddr, s_RegWrData, s_DMemWr, s_DMemAddr, s_DMemData,
Source: src/RISCV_Processor.vhd (every instance in its architecture is shown).
